purpose: extend state-resolved ecological prediction with explicit uncertainty, extrapolation diagnostics and multi-level transfer profiles while preserving the frozen v4 submission state

conformal_state_uncertainty.input: out-of-sample or separately calibrated normalized state probabilities
conformal_state_uncertainty.method: split conformal with nonconformity score 1 - p(true_state)
conformal_state_uncertainty.primary_output: finite state prediction set at caller-declared miscoverage
conformal_state_uncertainty.guarantee: finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability between calibration and target rows

environmental_novelty.scaling: training mean and population standard deviation; constant features use scale one
environmental_novelty.strict_extrapolation: any query feature outside the training univariate range
environmental_novelty.multivariate_novelty: nearest standardized training-row distance above a frozen quantile of leave-one-out training nearest-neighbour distances

generalization_profile.input: genuinely out-of-sample probability rows, realized state labels, training marginal state probabilities and caller-declared groupings
generalization_profile.classification: generalizing only if every group at that level is positive; non_generalizing if every group is non-positive; otherwise mixed

obligations: exchangeable conformal coverage is near nominal 0.90
strong outcome shift produces visibly degraded conformal coverage
strong environmental shift is marked as strict extrapolation
environmental novelty is invariant to positive affine feature rescaling
fine-level mixed transfer remains visible even if a coarser level aggregates to generalizing

out_of_scope_for_this_upgrade: automatic correction of detection or observation bias
